description: This file is a shell script intended to test the behavior of 'git push' with porcelain output under various scenarios, including different protocols, force options, atomic pushes, and pre-receive hook rejections. It defines multiple functions to set up repositories, create commits, and validate the output of push operations, making it a test script for Git functionality.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Generates an abbreviated form of a commit object ID, used for more stable output comparisons.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats git command outputs to replace commit IDs and URLs with placeholders for stable testing.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Processes the expected output for comparison, cleaning or formatting as needed.
